why: Lets an unrecognised style through to the URL, where the render layer's own reject-to-null parse quietly resolves it to the shipped default -- so a typo'd `--identityMarker shapes` captures the DEFAULT rendering while the operator believes they captured a candidate. Worse than an unstyled frame, because the frame looks like a legitimate comparison. Killed by the two-way pin against IDENTITY_MARKER_STYLES, which also fails if a style is added to the renderer without being added here.
